notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.notes:
There was a blocker at the end of winter level - now you can actually finish it (before this fix you can't)

Also, there was no truck at the start of winter cutscene (you probably have seen it at the trailer) - it's also fixed.

Thank you for playing and being there! Report to me bugs and I'll fix them as fast as I can.

notes.title: Release Date and Localizations
notes.notes:
Hi, and thank you for being here! I'm glad to announce the final release date of Save One More: May, 30, 2018! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32288172/46a2fbc58e9630e4f40ba77c93d509f122b65e5b.gif
Before that day, I send tonns of keys for press and youtubers, and some of them could make something even today, so you can search for stuff, if you are interested.

Also, a lot of awesome people contacted me, and Save One More will get localizations on English, German, French, Chinese. Russian and Ukrainian languages. English, Russian and Ukrainian are ready, others may be added after release date with patches.

If you are influencer, you can ask for a key through KeyMailer https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/58330 or via email at stas@shostak.games (but please, add a link to your channel or media, there are a lot of scum emails these days)

Thanks again, and I hope you will like the game!
